open_points.subject: A8 invalid run-setting validation
open_points.text:
| A8 | reading each run setting, its default, and the refusal of a value the start-up table does not accept | `runtime_settings` |
| A8 | the refusal of a port above 65535 and of a time zone the database does not know | `deliverer_service` |
open_points.question: Which module owns rejecting an out-of-range port and an unknown time zone, since both are values the start-up table does not accept?
options: `deliverer_service` receives them from `runtime_settings` and rejects them
open_points.default_guess: `runtime_settings` owns both rejections because it alone reads and validates run settings; `deliverer_service` only orchestrates startup.

witness.initial: All required environment variables are valid except `PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT=70000`.
events: The startup path reaches the port-range check.
outcomes: `runtime_settings` refuses the value and never returns a `RuntimeSettings` object.
`runtime_settings` returns a settings object containing 70000, and `deliverer_service` refuses it afterward.
witness.observer: A module-boundary test or maintainer implementing `load_runtime_settings` and service startup sees which module must contain the check.

open_points.subject: AuthenticationRequired response mapping
open_points.text:
The router checks no token: the extractor of the `Authorization` field that the backend emits raises
`AuthenticationRequired`, and the router maps that exception to 401 with an empty body, so it imports it from
`deliverer_api`.
open_points.question: How can `deliverer_router` map an authentication refusal to an HTTP answer when its module rules say it must not own any refusal answer and `deliverer_api` owns the status and content of every refusal answer?
options: Remove the router's exception mapper because none of its routes uses the extractor
Declare the generated empty 401 mapper an explicit exception to the router's ownership prohibition
Move authentication extraction and its refusal answer to the router
Keep authentication and all reachable refusal mapping in `deliverer_api`, but specify why the unreachable generated mapper is not ownership
open_points.default_guess: Remove the unused extractor and empty-401 mapper from the generated router surface so every authentication refusal remains an M08 answer owned by `deliverer_api`.

open_points.subject: `domain_models` ownership note
open_points.text: - no exception: the refusal types belong to `refusals`, and `AuthenticationRequired` to `deliverer_api`.
open_points.rule:
- note, которая не должна создавать ребро, не называет чужой экспорт целым
      словом
open_points.question: Rewrite the note without naming the foreign export `AuthenticationRequired` as a whole word, or declare the dependency edge that the name is intended to create.
